name: 01-cb-headers-only.csv
scenario: Header row only, no tips → "no-data" stage, no $0/NaN on screen

name: 02-cb-tiny-import.csv
scenario: 5 tips, 1 short session → "tiny-import" stage, locked cards explain what is needed

name: 03-cb-first-valid-data.csv
scenario: 30 tips, 2 valid sessions, ≥$10 → "first-valid-data" stage

name: 04-cb-growing-insights.csv
scenario: 120 tips, 6 valid sessions, ≥$50 → "growing-insights" stage

name: 05-cb-full-dashboard.csv
scenario: 300 tips, 12 valid sessions, ≥$100 → "full-dashboard" stage

name: 06-cb-whale-and-shark.csv
scenario: whale01 = $120 over 12 tips (Whale); shark01 = $30 over 6 tips (Shark); rest small tippers

name: 07-cb-short-sessions-invalid.csv
scenario: 8 sessions of 15 min → none pass the 30-min valid-session rule; hourly rate must say "Not enough data yet"

name: 08-cb-midnight-crossing.csv
scenario: Sessions 11:15 PM → 1:15 AM; one session must not split into two days

name: 09-cb-dst-fallback.csv
scenario: Stream across US DST end (Nov 1, 2026 1–2 AM repeats); hours must stay on the creator clock

name: 10-cb-duplicate-rows.csv
scenario: Every row appears twice → dedup must keep 60 tips, not 120

expect.note: parseCSV keeps all rows; insert_tips_dedup removes duplicates on import

name: 11-cb-native-with-transfers.csv
scenario: Native Chaturbate paste; transfers, outbound tips and admin deductions are NOT earnings

name: 12-cb-native-private-shows.csv
scenario: Private shows mixed with tips; Top Tipper must exclude private revenue, Top Spender includes it

name: 13-bonga-free-chat.csv
scenario: BongaCams DD.MM.YYYY dates, $0.025/token

expect.note: parser rounds each row to cents; see README known issue

name: 14-bonga-paid-chat-types.csv
scenario: Mix of Tip / Private / Full-Private / Group / Spy Mode; paid chat is not a manual tip

name: 15-bonga-day-month-ambiguous.csv
scenario: Dates like 03.04 must read as 3 April (DD.MM), never 4 March

name: 16-mfc-ordinal-dates.csv
scenario: MyFreeCams "Sep 1st, 2026 9:00 PM" ordinal dates

name: 17-multi-3-platforms.csv
scenario: 3 platforms → allowed on Free (1 Primary + 2 Secondary)

name: 18-multi-4-platforms-free-limit.csv
scenario: 4 platforms → Free must block the 4th with the platform-limit message; Pro allows

name: 19-secondary-older-than-31-days.csv
scenario: Secondary platform with June + October data → Free shows only the last 31 days; Pro shows all

name: 20-malformed-rows.csv
scenario: Bad date, missing tokens, text in tokens, negative, blank line, extra column → bad rows skipped, no crash, no NaN

expect.note: keeps fan01 x2 and fan06 (extra column ignored); drops bad date, blank, text and negative tokens
